lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; exact lc
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case' app l r il ir =>
    have := r.wf.2.1
    rcases il rfl l.wf.2.1 with vl | ⟨_, hl⟩
    case' inl =>
      rcases ir rfl r.wf.2.1 with vr | ⟨_, hr⟩
      case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
  case' tapp d s ih => have := (Sub.wf _ _ _ s).2.1.lc
  case' let' => have := (body_let.mp lc).2
  case' case d _ _ ih _ _ => have ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
  case' tapp d _ ih | let' d _ ih _ | inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih | case =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
  case' tapp.inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.inl => obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first | (left; constructor; assumption) | right
  all_goals apply Exists.intro
  all_goals solve_by_elim [Value.lc, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr,
    Red.let_body, Red.appᵣ]
